electrolysis.def: Using an electric current from an outside source to drive a redox reaction that is not thermodynamically favored, as in electroplating or producing a metal from its molten salt.

faraday-law.def: The amount of substance produced at an electrode is proportional to the charge passed: q = It, moles of electrons = q/F, and the half-reaction converts moles of electrons to moles of product.
